dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Mellow Yellow is at risk due to behavioral reasons. In his previous home he is noted to have a bite incident pertaining to resource guarding food that he had. Mellow's previous owner also states that he will lunge at cats while on leash. In care, Mellow is observed to become tense with a toy in his possession. With handlers, Mellow has a loose and wiggly body. Medically, Mellow has CIRDC and allergic dermatitis.

Mellow Yellow was brought to MACC as an owner surrender. In his previous home he is noted to have a bite incident pertaining to resource guarding food that he had. His previous owner also states that Mellow will lunge at cats while on leash. In care, Mellow is observed to persistently jump up on handlers amd become tense with a toy in his possession. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.

Volunteer Report: What a funny little character! His adorable grumpy face and slightly sassy attitude cracked me up throughout the interaction. This boy knows EXACTLY what he wants, and his priorities are clear: squeaky toys, treats! He was laser-focused whenever he heard a squeaky toy and caught treats midair like a pro. He accepted pets, but once he'd had enough, he was ready to move on to more important business. A bit independent, opinionated face, and hilariously charming. He definitely has his own agenda, and I loved every bit of his personality!
dog.name: Mello Yellow
